research.name: Terrae
research.note: Composable React map components on Mapbox and MapLibre, including animated overlays such as a volcano eruption, a cyclone and a meteor strike.

effects: Volcano eruption overlay with a lava and ash plume on the map
Cyclone overlay with a swirling particle funnel
Meteor strike overlay with scattering impact particles
Lightning overlay with a branching bolt striking the map
Tsunami overlay with an incoming wave, foam and debris particles
